{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans are defenders of the First Amendment Right to Religious Liberty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The First Amendment Right to Religious Liberty protects the Right to Worship according to the dictates of Conscience.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The First Amendment Right to Religious Liberty protects the Right to act in accordance with those Beliefs, not just in places of Worship, but in everyday life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support a new Federal Task Force on Fighting Anti-Christian Bias.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Federal Task Force on Fighting Anti-Christian Bias will investigate all forms of illegal discrimination, harassment, and persecution against Christians in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will protect and defend a vote of the People, from within the States, on the Issue of Life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 14th Amendment to the Constitution of the United States guarantees that no person can be denied Life or Liberty without Due Process.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The States are free to pass Laws protecting Life and Liberty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The power to protect Life and Liberty has been given to the States and to a vote of the People after 51 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will oppose Late Term Abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will support mothers and policies that advance Prenatal Care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will support policies that advance access to Birth Control.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will support policies that advance IVF (fertility treatments).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
